subject: Post-call: scope alignment, approval gates & proposed MAP
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: scope alignment, approval gates & proposed MAP

Hi Claire —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps I promised. I tried to keep this tight so your procurement and security teams can scan easily.

1) High-level scope we discussed
- Pilot scope: 10k monthly inference tokens for clinician summarization workloads, redaction on PHI, S3 ingress only.
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 350ms, accuracy on redaction test set >= 98%, and no sensitive-data egress.

2) Key stakeholders (from today's call) — please correct/add:
- Economic / Budget owner: Claire Huang (you)
- Security reviewer / CISO: Diane Ross (you mentioned)
- Procurement / Legal: Ethan Cole (procurement@luminahealth.ai)

3) Immediate asks from Lumina (what you asked us to provide)
- SOC 2 evidence + data retention policy
- Encryption & KMS architecture diagram
- SOW template for procurement review

Attachments: I’ve attached a compact evidence pack and a draft SOW for your procurement team (redwood-evidence-pack.zip, Lumina_SOW_template_v1.pdf).

4) Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — draft milestones and owners (we're flexible):
- 2028-05-20: Security pre-screen (Lumina: Diane) — receive SOC 2 + retention policy (Alex/Monica to provide)
- 2028-05-27: Tech deep-dive & integration plan (Alex + Monica) — demo POC env + network/firewall requirements
- 2028-06-03: Procurement review & redlines (Lumina: Ethan) — exchange SOW/contract draft
- 2028-06-10: Executive approval / budget sign-off (Lumina: Claire)
- 2028-06-17: POC kickoff (shared owners)

5) Decision criteria we propose Lumina validate internally:
- Technical: latency & accuracy thresholds above
- Security: SOC 2 type II, on-prem data residency controls or VPC peering option, KMS integration
- Commercial: committed monthly tokens for discounted rate or reserved capacity

Next steps from our side: Monica will compile the evidence bundle and Priyom will put together a compact pricing/commitment sheet for the POC. Can you confirm the names/emails for Diane and Ethan so we loop them in directly? Also, does the 2028-05-20 pre-screen date work on your side?

Thanks again — looking forward to aligning the approval gates.

—
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
alex@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142
From: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lumina Health Procurement <procurement@luminahealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: scope alignment, approval gates & proposed MAP

Alex —

Appreciate the concise summary. Confirming the stakeholder list and a couple of clarifications:
- Diane Ross (CISO) will lead security sign-off; copy: diane.ross@luminahealth.ai
- Ethan Cole is the procurement lead; copy: ethan.cole@luminahealth.ai
- Legal reviewer: Jennifer Park, legal@luminahealth.ai (she’ll handle contract redlines)

The 2028-05-20 pre-screen looks OK but can we move to 2028-05-21 (we have a leadership offsite on the 20th)? If you can deliver the SOC 2 pack and retention policy by end of day 2028-05-18, that gives our team time to pre-read.

Decision criteria note: our exec team will also weight integration effort (estimated FTEs) and runbook for incident response — can you provide a short draft runbook or summary of your incident escalation path?

I will loop Diane, Ethan and Jennifer once we have the evidence pack. For now, go ahead and send the SOC 2 + SOW.

Claire
Head of Product & Partnerships | Lumina Health
claire@luminahealth.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence pack + runbook snippet attached

Claire / team —

Per Alex's ask, attached is the compact evidence bundle (redwood-evidence-pack.zip) containing:
- SOC_2_Type_II_summary.pdf (summary + scope)
- data_retention_policy.txt (policy highlights and retention windows)
- kms_integration_diagram.png (how we integrate with customer KMS/HSM)
- incident_runbook_excerpt.md (short form: detection -> severity -> pager -> remediation ownership)

Key notes:
- We support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK) and can provide key rotation docs on request.
- Data at rest is encrypted AES-256; in-transit TLS1.2+.
- For PHI workflows we recommend VPC peering + prefix/KV caching disabled for initial POC.

Action items for our side:
- Priyom: pricing/commitment sheet for the 10k-token pilot (will send by EOD 18 May).
- Alex: propose times for 2028-05-21 security pre-screen and 2028-05-27 tech deep-dive.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing + MAP update

Claire —

Attached: compact pricing & commitment sheet (inline summary below).
- POC (10k tokens/month): free POC for 4 weeks with usage telemetry; post-POC options are: pay-as-you-go ($0.0025/token) or reserved capacity (monthly commit) which reduces unit cost by ~45%.

MAP update (incorporating your date change):
- 2028-05-21: Security pre-screen (Lumina: Diane) — Redwood to confirm evidence delivered (Monica)
- 2028-05-27: Tech deep-dive & network checklist (Redwood: Alex/Monica)
- 2028-06-03: Procurement & legal redline exchange (Lumina: Ethan/Jennifer)
- 2028-06-10: Exec budget approval (Lumina: Claire)
- 2028-06-17: POC kickoff

One small ask from our procurement team — can you confirm if Lumina requires vendor SSOW or a third-party risk assessment prior to signature? If yes, we can surface a template. Also adding a short canary/rollback clause to the SOW is standard for POC; I’ve suggested a line in the draft SOW we shared.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Pricing | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diane Ross <diane.ross@luminahealth.ai>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminahealth.ai>, Jennifer Park <legal@luminahealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing + MAP update

Team —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the MAP draft. This looks actionable and I appreciate the explicit owners/dates. A couple of confirmations from Lumina:
- We do require a basic 3rd-party security questionnaire + SSAE/SOC evidence before legal signs. Diane — I’ll coordinate offline for any follow-ups.
- Procurement prefers a short SOW + canary rollback language — Jennifer, Ethan, please review the draft SOW Alex attached and flag redlines by 2028-06-03.

Claire (for execs): The main decision criteria we’ll use are (1) security posture, (2) integration lift (FTEs & timeline), (3) predictable cost model for production, and (4) vendor support SLA for incidents. If Redwood can commit to the evidence delivery and the canary clause, we’ll move to procurement review.

I’ve created a HubSpot deal and added your MAP as tasks: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-12456 — I’ll add Diane/Ethan/Jennifer as participants. When you’re ready, please push the SOW to DocuSign and I’ll route it internally for signatures.

Best,
Claire
